readme:
# TikTok Shop Product Details (V2) API

Retrieve TikTok Shop product information by supplying a `product_id`. You can also narrow results by setting `region` and `seller_id`.

## Use cases

- Inspect basic product metadata on TikTok Shop.
- Monitor specific shop inventory across supported countries.
- Track individual TikTok Shop listings by product ID.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/tiktok/shop-web/product-detail-v2" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"product_id": "<product_id>"}'
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `product_id` | string | Yes | Product ID (required) |
| `region` | string | No | Region code (US/GB/SG/MY/PH/TH/VN/ID) |
| `seller_id` | string | No | Seller ID (can be empty string) |

## Notes

- Supported `region` codes include US, GB, SG, MY, PH, TH, VN, and ID.
- `seller_id` can be left as an empty string if unknown.

## Pricing

Flat price per call. Failed calls, including lookups whose target does not exist, are not charged.

## Related APIs

- [TikTok Shop Product Details](/model/tiktok/shop-web/product-detail): Retrieves full product details and page component information from TikTok Shop by product ID.
- [TikTok Shop Product Detail (V3)](/model/tiktok/shop-web/product-detail-v3): Returns comprehensive TikTok Shop product data including shop information, videos, and recommendations for a given product ID across supported regions.
- [TikTok Shop Product ID by Share Link](/model/tiktok/shop-web/product-id-by-share-link): Returns the TikTok Shop product identifier extracted from a provided product share link.
